answer: Cosignatures are collected in terrace, verified in garden, and tundra names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 28 submissions per epoch. Repeating the trick 35 times costs 9 separate deposits and 46 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
